T-HUB.note:

WHAT B IS: a hub read as a DECISION rather than a shop window. A split-screen hero with two real doors (the page's action left, the page's own second offer right), then a field of index ROWS read top to bottom, each a thumbnail plus a name plus one plain line that lets the reader ELIMINATE it, then an escape rail, a two-cell in-house argument, a quote-only cost band on the deep ground, an address ledger, and a one-sentence close. That is not a property a template can be said to have. The 2026-08-14 checkpoint's row table counted COPY blocks and was wrong: this template MOVES a page's escape block into the hero, so the field renders one fewer than the copy lists.

TWO THINGS WENT WRONG GETTING HERE AND BOTH ARE WORTH KNOWING.
(1) A LITERAL SECTION TAG WAS WRITTEN INSIDE A LEDGER COMMENT. The regex-based gates count section tags without parsing HTML, so it read as a REAL sixth section: verify-section-rhythm passed for the WRONG REASON on a phantom bookend while verify-not-flat reported 4 sections and 1 dark ground on a page that has 5 and 2. Never quote a section tag in a comment in these fragments.
(2) THE GROUND OVERRIDE SHIPPED FOUR INVISIBLE LINKS BEFORE IT WAS CAUGHT. This concept deliberately spent its only dark ground on the CREDENTIAL at position 2 and left the close to take depth from geometry, which failed verify-section-visual-rhythm's ">= 2 non-light anchors" rule. Moving the close to .surface-dark fixed the rule and took the promote to 52/52 - and rendered .ar-rail__l at rgb(14,89,82) on rgb(11,65,61), which is 1.40:1. .ar-rail__l takes var(--ds-primary), which the token sheet itself designates the SOLID FILL role on dark (it also marks --ds-signature "2.47:1 on dark. DECORATION ONLY here"). THE PAGE SCORED 52/52 IN THAT STATE with section-density, section-rhythm, mobile-quality and no-text-overlap all green: contrast is not in that battery, so a ground flip can pass every gate and still ship unreadable text. A DOM-walk contrast probe reported a comfortable 7.38:1 and was WRONG, because .surface-dark paints its ground as a background-IMAGE, so backgroundColor is transparent and the walk climbs to a light ancestor. Only PAINTED PIXELS found the real number. Fixed with .surface-dark .ar-rail__l{color:var(--ds-ink)} and re-measured at 10.11:1.
A BUILD-WIDE BLOCKER WAS CLEARED TO LAND THAT ONE-LINE FIX. verify-design-foundation fails CLOSED on the WHOLE structural sheet, so seven unrelated (A3) ch-max-width findings in sections 10, 11 and 12 - .bw-legal, .lg-close, .ix-lead, .ix-close-t, label.ct-consent__text, address.ct-office__addr, .ct-pend - blocked EVERY edit to radiantsmiles-structural.css, including this one. Each was restated from ch to rem at its MEASURED computed max-width at a verified 16px root, the same remedy the section 7 promotion used. PROVEN NOT TO MOVE ANYTHING: smile-gallery and contact diffed PIXEL-IDENTICAL full-page at 1440, and privacy-policy's two rules re-measured at the same 708px and 668px. Its 84,826-pixel diff was proven to be CAPTURE NOISE by shooting the same page twice with the same method and no change between, which produced the identical 84,826.

COPY.note:
OWNER DECISION 2026-08-17: "we don't have that", given in answer to the four-decision packet covering the clinician roster, the offer terms, the review-rating scope and insurance. Recorded as a real answer, not a deferral: where the practice does not hold a fact, the copy STATES the limitation rather than holding a placeholder open for it.
WHAT THE OWNER SAW: the decision packet (published artifact), which carried the four questions, the item and page counts behind each, a worked example of the refusal language from the team copy, and what ships today under each. WHAT THE OWNER DID NOT SEE: the 66-page corpus page by page. That is stated plainly because this stamp would otherwise imply a line-by-line read that did not happen. The corpus was machine-verified instead, and the verification is quoted below with its own stated ceiling.
WHAT THE ANSWER RESOLVES: 107 of the 236 open items, across 62 of the 66 pages, are availability questions - does this fact exist, or supply it. They are now closed as ABSENT. In every one of those cases the copy was already shipping the honest version, so nothing about what renders changes; what changes is that the questions stop being open. Concretely: the entry offer ships with NO expiry, NO exclusions and NO senior-age threshold and therefore NO urgency framing anywhere on the site; the Birdeye 4.5 / 506 record stays permanently scoped to the Lake Mead office with its platform and fetch date attached and is never aggregated; no page offers to check a patient's benefits or claims an in-network relationship; and no page states which clinician works at which office.
WHAT THE ANSWER DOES NOT RESOLVE, AND THIS IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. A residue of items are CONFLICTS rather than gaps: the practice's own published data contradicts itself, so "we don't have that" cannot settle them because the problem is two competing facts, not a missing one. Each ships today on a documented safe default, and each remains OPEN:
  (1) SUNRISE MANOR ZIP. 89107 appears site-wide, 89104 appears in the booking block. SHIPS: 89107, carried from client-rules.json contactData, the locked source. AFFECTS 13 pages. NAP consistency, and therefore local search, depends on which is right.
  (2) THE CLINICIAN ROSTER'S CURRENCY. Ten clinicians are named from the practice's own roster page captured 30 July 2026, and THREE of those biographies - Quizon, Andrade, Schaudt - are served from URLs and page titles naming a DIFFERENT doctor. Identification was verified first-hand against the page bindings, so the names in the copy are right, but the roster has not been reconfirmed. SHIPS: the ten captured names. AFFECTS 10 clinician pages plus every page that references the roster.
  (3) NORTH DECATUR'S HOURS are byte identical to Lone Mountain's seven published rows. SHIPS: the published rows, with no "next open" value derived from them.
  (4) PRIVACY POLICY names an office "Centennial" where contactData names that same phone number North Decatur. SHIPS: as captured, unaltered, because legal text is never rewritten by this pipeline. Needs counsel, as does confirming info@radiantsmilesnv.com is the correct mailbox for data requests.
  (5) BLUE DIAMOND publishes no Tuesday, Friday or Sunday hours anywhere. SHIPS: those three days as "Call for hours", never as "Closed", which would be an invented fact.
  (6) ADULT BRACES bracket types. The live site describes metal, clear synthetic and tooth-coloured ceramic; whether that is still accurate is unconfirmed, so the option language is held out of the hero.
MEASURED GREEN: _audit/verify-all-66.mjs re-run at this stamp - CLEAN ON EVERY CHECK, 66/66. Zero gate failures across the two in-scope gates, zero content findings, zero missing fact tokens, zero missing brief D-IDs, zero missing brief sections, zero pages without a brief. Its self-test passed 23 content patterns across 113 fixtures. Gate applicability was re-established with KNOWN-BAD CANARIES rather than assumed: G-NODASH and G-BANNED fired exit 2 on the probe and are IN SCOPE; G-FIDELITY, G-OWNER and G-SEAM returned exit 0 on the known-bad probe and are correctly recorded NOT IN SCOPE for _copy/*.md rather than counted as passes.
THE CEILING, IN THE RUNNER'S OWN WORDS, because a stamp should not claim more than its evidence: "the gates prove payload presence and mechanics. The content patterns above are mine and catch only what they were written to catch. Neither layer reads the page. A clean run here is a floor, not a verdict."
STRUCTURAL STATE AT THIS STAMP: 66 copy files, 66 sitemap nodes, 66 briefs; every node carries exactly one type; all five governing docs present; 66/66 files carry a warning-marked flag, a source or fetch marker, and a compliance appendix.
WHAT THE 236 ITEMS ARE NOT: they are not defects. Each is the copy declining to invent a fact, which is the behaviour this pipeline exists to produce. The per-file warning lines are DELIBERATELY LEFT IN PLACE as the provenance trail for why each page says what it says - "no expiry is published anywhere on the live site" remains true and remains the justification for the shape of that page's offer line.
